error.subscriber_already_installed: A tracing subscriber is already installed; Runique log configuration is inactive (RUST_LOG / with_log have no effect)
error.external_outputs_ignored: `with_log(|l| l.external())` is set; configured log outputs are ignored (the application owns the subscriber)
error.driver_not_enabled:
{} driver not enabled: Runique was compiled with '{}', not '{}'.

If .env points at the wrong database (the features changed, .env didn't), set DB_ENGINE and DATABASE_URL to the compiled engine: '{}'.

To use {} instead, in your project's Cargo.toml and migration/Cargo.toml:
runique = { version = "{}", features = ["{}"] }

For the runique CLI:
cargo install runique-cli --features {} --locked --force

To support every engine, use the 'all-databases' feature.
error.db_missing: Database connection required when 'orm' feature is enabled
error.db_required: Database connection or configuration required (`orm` feature enabled)
error.admin_prefix_empty: The admin route prefix cannot be empty
error.media_root_unusable: Cannot create or access MEDIA_ROOT directory '{}': {}
error.secret_key_weak: SECRET_KEY is missing, empty, the default value, or shorter than 32 characters
error.public_url_missing: No public URL: password reset links would be built from the request's Host header
error.acme_domain_missing: ACME_ENABLED=true but ACME_DOMAIN is not set
error.acme_email_missing: ACME_ENABLED=true but ACME_EMAIL is not set
error.mailer_missing: Password reset without a mailer: the link could never be sent
error.locales_invalid: The project's translations folder is invalid: {}

hint.db_required: Add .with_database(db) or .with_database_config(config) to your construction chain
hint.admin_prefix_empty: Use .prefix("/admin") or leave the default value
hint.cache_control_invalid: Use only visible ASCII characters (no control characters, no newlines).
hint.media_root_unusable: Set MEDIA_ROOT to an absolute writable path in your .env (e.g. MEDIA_ROOT=/var/www/myapp/media) and ensure the process has write permission.
hint.secret_key_weak: Set SECRET_KEY to a random 32+ character string in your .env file (the `runique` CLI can generate one)
hint.acme_domain_missing: Set ACME_DOMAIN to your production domain in your .env file
hint.acme_email_missing: Set ACME_EMAIL to your Let's Encrypt contact email in your .env file
hint.mailer_missing: Set it in .env: EMAIL_BACKEND, or SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS

log.debug_in_prod: DEBUG=true in production: every visitor sees the detailed error pages, and every log channel is on — the logs hold what visitors type in forms (passwords excepted). Turn it off once the problem is found
log.prune_failed: orphan rights prune failed — stale grants may remain
log.locales_missing: project translations, language '{}': {} message(s) of Runique not translated ({}), shown in its fallback language
log.locales_unknown: project translations, language '{}': key(s) Runique doesn't know in one of its subjects, without effect: {}
log.locales_placeholders: project translations, language '{}': number of parameters different from that of Runique's message: {}
